description:
What is This Part?
This is a NEW Suzuki Radiator Cap.
This Radiator Cap is a Direct Replacement for your Suzuki Samurai.
If you have been losing water out of your radiator due to blow-back then this part may be exactly what you need.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Radiator Cap
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
